name: Regular
description: Employee with security of tenure after probationary period

name: Probationary
description: On trial period, usually 3–6 months, before regularization

name: Contractual
description: Hired under a contract with a fixed term of employment

name: Project-Based
description: Hired only for the duration of a specific project

name: Seasonal
description: Employed only during peak or seasonal demand

name: Casual
description: Hired for incidental work, not usually necessary to business operations

name: Part-Time
description: Works fewer hours than regular employees

name: Job Order / Freelance
description: Paid based on output or deliverables, no employer-employee relationship
